{
  "format": "kassensturz-dashboard", "version": 4, "kind": "dashboard", "template": "overview", "default": true,
  "name": "Overview",
  "components": [
    {"id": "dashboard-tabs", "type": "page.tabs",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 0, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "period-header", "type": "page.period",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 1, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "filter-bar", "type": "page.filters",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 2, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "welcome", "type": "text.heading", "props": {"text": "Welcome to the Summerfield family! Here is how the household money stands."},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 3, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "account-0", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003"]},
     "props": {"title": "Checking account"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 4, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "account-1", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000007"]},
     "props": {"title": "Jonas's checking account"},
     "frame": {"col": 4, "row": 4, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "account-2", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000005"]},
     "props": {"title": "Household account"},
     "frame": {"col": 8, "row": 4, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "account-3", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000008"]},
     "props": {"title": "Savings account"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 7, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "account-4", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000006"]},
     "props": {"title": "Instant access savings"},
     "frame": {"col": 4, "row": 7, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "account-5", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth", "accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000004"]},
     "props": {"title": "Credit card"},
     "frame": {"col": 8, "row": 7, "cols": 4, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "budgets", "type": "budget.progress", "dataset": "budget_utilization",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 10, "cols": 12, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "spent-this-month", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "expenses", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "props": {"title": "Spent this month"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 14, "cols": 6, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "rest-of-salary", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "formula", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "props": {"title": "Left of the salary", "formula": "=Salary - Spending.ALL"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 14, "cols": 6, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "candles", "type": "chart.candlestick", "dataset": "cash_flow_by_month",
     "params": {"accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003"]},
     "props": {"title": "Balance, month by month", "period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 16, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending", "type": "chart.donut", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "top_level_category"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 16, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "against-average", "type": "table.rows", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "top_level_category", "compare": "average-3"},
     "props": {"title": "This month against the average of the three months before"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 21, "cols": 12, "rows": 6}},
    {"id": "flow", "type": "chart.flow", "dataset": "money_flow",
     "params": {"show_accounts": true},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 27, "cols": 12, "rows": 7}},
    {"id": "transfers", "type": "notice.transfers",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 34, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "unsorted", "type": "notice.unsorted",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 35, "cols": 12, "rows": 2}}
  ]
}

{
  "format": "kassensturz-dashboard", "version": 4, "kind": "dashboard",
  "name": "More",
  "components": [
    {"id": "dashboard-tabs", "type": "page.tabs",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 0, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "period-header", "type": "page.period",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 1, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "filter-bar", "type": "page.filters",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 2, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "spending-heading", "type": "text.heading", "props": {"text": "What the money was spent on"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 3, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "spending-share", "type": "chart.pie", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "top_level_category"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 4, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-compared", "type": "table.rows", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "category", "compare": "same_last_year"},
     "props": {"title": "Compared with a year earlier", "neutral": "5"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 4, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-against-last-month", "type": "chart.bar", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "top_level_category", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 9, "cols": 12, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-areas", "type": "chart.stacked_bar", "dataset": "category_over_time",
     "params": {"series": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000018", "019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000028", "019a0000-0000-7000-8000-00000000001b"]},
     "props": {"title": "The three big areas, month by month", "period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 14, "cols": 12, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-this-month", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"measure": "total", "compare": "same_last_year"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 19, "cols": 6, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "spending-this-year", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"measure": "total"},
     "props": {"title": "Spent this year", "period": "this-year"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 19, "cols": 6, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "spending-food", "type": "chart.line", "dataset": "category_over_time",
     "params": {"series": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000018"]},
     "props": {"title": "Food, month by month", "period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 21, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-average", "type": "table.rows", "dataset": "spending_by_category",
     "params": {"grouping": "top_level_category", "average": "per-month"},
     "props": {"title": "On average per month this year", "period": "this-year"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 21, "cols": 6, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "spending-newest", "type": "table.transactions",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 26, "cols": 12, "rows": 5}},
    {"id": "money-heading", "type": "text.heading", "props": {"text": "Where the money came from and where it went"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 31, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "money-flow", "type": "chart.flow", "dataset": "money_flow",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 32, "cols": 12, "rows": 6}},
    {"id": "money-in-and-out", "type": "chart.bar", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "props": {"period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 38, "cols": 12, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-candles", "type": "chart.candlestick", "dataset": "cash_flow_by_month",
     "params": {"accounts": ["019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003"]},
     "props": {"title": "Balance, month by month", "period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 42, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-worth", "type": "chart.area", "dataset": "net_worth_over_time",
     "props": {"period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 42, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-last-year", "type": "group.period",
     "props": {"title": "Last year", "period": "last-year"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 46, "cols": 12, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-year-income", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "income", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 47, "cols": 3, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "money-year-expenses", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "expenses", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "frame": {"col": 3, "row": 47, "cols": 3, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "money-year-left", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "net", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 47, "cols": 3, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "money-year-kept", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "params": {"measure": "savings-rate", "compare": "previous_period"},
     "frame": {"col": 9, "row": 47, "cols": 3, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "money-sources", "type": "table.income_sources",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 50, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-months", "type": "table.rows", "dataset": "cash_flow_by_month",
     "props": {"period": "last-12-months"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 50, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "money-transfers", "type": "notice.transfers",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 54, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "plans-heading", "type": "text.heading", "props": {"text": "What there is, what is coming and what to watch"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 55, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "plans-have", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "assets"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 56, "cols": 4, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "plans-owe", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "liabilities"},
     "frame": {"col": 4, "row": 56, "cols": 4, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "plans-worth", "type": "kpi.card", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"measure": "net_worth"},
     "frame": {"col": 8, "row": 56, "cols": 4, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "plans-accounts-bars", "type": "chart.bar", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"grouping": "account"},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 58, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "plans-accounts", "type": "table.rows", "dataset": "account_balances",
     "params": {"grouping": "account"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 58, "cols": 6, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "plans-budgets", "type": "budget.progress", "dataset": "budget_utilization",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 62, "cols": 12, "rows": 4}},
    {"id": "plans-left-this-month", "type": "forecast.month",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 66, "cols": 6, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "plans-coming-up", "type": "plan.coming_up",
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 66, "cols": 6, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "plans-warnings", "type": "notice.alarms",
     "props": {"title": "Warnings", "alarms": [
       {"reason": "account_below", "account": "019a0000-0000-7000-8000-000000000003", "amount": "2000.00"}]},
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 69, "cols": 6, "rows": 3}},
    {"id": "plans-goal", "type": "progress.bar", "dataset": "income_expense_by_month",
     "props": {"title": "Monthly goal for food", "formula": "'Food'", "target": "1500"},
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 69, "cols": 6, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "plans-unsorted", "type": "notice.unsorted",
     "frame": {"col": 6, "row": 70, "cols": 6, "rows": 2}},
    {"id": "plans-line", "type": "text.separator",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 72, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}},
    {"id": "plans-fetch-gaps", "type": "notice.fetch_gap",
     "frame": {"col": 0, "row": 73, "cols": 12, "rows": 1}}
  ]
}
